ours-tiling.short: Night School's matmul emulator and kernels, built for this film
ours-tiling.citation: media/school/tiling/facts.json, written by tools/school/fill_tiling.mjs from system/school/tiling.mjs: naive and tiled WGSL matmul kernels, an exact emulator of global and shared memory traffic, barriers and arithmetic for n = 64 to 1,024, a float32 tolerance and a missing-barrier control.
claims: The stale-tile kernel fails at every size.
ours-tiling.does_not_prove: Any timing; caches are not modelled.
